description_en: Modifies the disk type of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 MongoDB 版的磁盘类型
name: ModifyDBInstanceDiskType

parameters.help_en:
The disk type after the modification. Valid value:

cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的磁盘类型，取值：
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: The provisioned IOPS. Valid values: 0 to 50000
parameters.help_zh: 预配置性能（IOPS）。取值范围为 0~50000
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: Enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

<props="china">

false: Disables automatic payment. To pay for the order, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the navigation pane on the left, choose Subscription Orders > My Orders. On the Product Orders tab, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


<props="intl">

false: Disables automatic payment. To pay for the order, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the navigation pane on the left, click Order Management. On the Product Orders page, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


Default value: true

true：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。

parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The business information. This is an additional parameter
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. The default value is `youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
true：开启自动续费。
false：不开启自动续费。

默认值为 false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:

UPGRADE: Upgrades the instance configuration.

DOWNGRADE: Downgrades the instance configuration.

This parameter is available only when the instance uses the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值：

UPGRADE：升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，该参数可用
parameters.name: order_type
